overview: A shared ultra-high-vacuum bonding resource for semiconductor–semiconductor and semiconductor–diamond integration. Surface activation, alignment, pressure, and post-bond annealing are selected for each material pair.
overviewZh: 用于半导体-半导体及半导体-金刚石异质集成的共享超高真空键合资源。表面活化、对准、压力和后退火条件需针对材料组合确定。
principle: Energetic neutral or ion irradiation cleans and activates mating surfaces in vacuum. Bringing sufficiently smooth, aligned surfaces into contact enables low-temperature bonding. Bond quality depends on contamination, roughness and beam damage; the interfacial layer and any annealing treatment are material-dependent.
principleZh: 在真空中用高能中性束或离子束清洁并活化待键合表面，将足够平整、对准的表面接触，实现低温键合。键合质量受污染、粗糙度与束流损伤影响，界面层及后续退火需按材料组合确定。
